storyline.real: Alonso wins from 11th on the grid; Vettel retires from the lead and Räikkönen, from 5th, finishes second, 6.4 s behind Alonso.
storyline.headline: Räikkönen takes Valencia away from Alonso

mastery.label: Beat Alonso on two stops or fewer

eras.briefing: Valencia, 2012. Vettel leads from pole and you run Räikkönen, sixth after starting fifth. Alonso started 11th and is coming through the field. Finish ahead of him.
